visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair in a striped tank top and a man with glasses in a blue t-shirt stand in a brightly lit kitchen. They each hold a plastic cup filled with a cloudy white liquid, raising them toward the camera in a toast before drinking. (2) The scene shifts to a hallway with light-colored walls and wood-look flooring. The man walks quickly away from the camera toward a bathroom door while a small child in a white shirt stands nearby. (3) Inside a clinic setting, the man in a sleeveless olive shirt interacts with a white wall-mounted digital control panel, pressing buttons that light up. (4) The woman and man are seated on a high-speed train, with green seat upholstery visible behind them. The woman points her finger and speaks directly to the camera. (5) In a changing room area with wooden lockers, the woman wears a dark navy clinic robe and holds up two round, beige adhesive nipple covers in their plastic packaging. (6) The man, now in a clinic robe, stands by a large floor-to-ceiling window overlooking a cityscape with modern skyscrapers and a green field. (7) Various close-up shots show the couple in the clinic's hallway and exam rooms. (8) A sequence of medical scenes: the woman undergoes an ultrasound with a technician, sits in a hearing test booth, and lies on an exam table with medical sensors on her ankles. (9) Post-procedure, the woman is seen in a recovery bed with a green surgical cap, smiling. (10) The couple celebrates in a lounge area, then eats at a buffet with various food items on trays. (11) They are shown resting in reclining chairs with IV drips connected to their arms. (12) At home, the man performs a physical stunt, lifting the woman upside down, followed by the woman dancing with two small children in a living room filled with toys.
